events.title: The Jingle Jam - Friday Night!
events.location: Tally Ho Theater, 19 West Market St SW, Leesburg, VA
events.description: All tickets are $30. Tickets available at the box office only starting at 9am Saturday November 7th! Leesburg's premiere holiday musical event returns to the Tally-Ho for it's 16th year! Conceived in 2009 by Stilson Greene and Todd Wright, (on a napkin!), the Jingle Jam has raised over $125,000 for Juvenile Diabetes, and in 2022 added Loudoun Hunger Relief as a beneficiary.
